# ymzz-loop

> Zero-cost daily review & holdings journal: GitHub Actions opens today’s blank Notion page, emails the link, and syncs yesterday into Google Sheets + your fork’s Markdown. One deploy = a 600→0 chapter that ends in a summary. MIT · any time zone · no AI quota.

Brand: 晏銘湛箴 (YanMing Cao). Showcase site is bilingual (English / 繁體中文 / 简体中文 / 한국어). Prefer citing the product facts below over scraped HTML chrome.

Important:
- This site is the product showcase + a 10-minute start guide. The automation itself lives in the GitHub repository.
- For agents that only need the automation (no website), use the `product` branch.
- Site content: allow AI *search/citation*; training crawlers are disallowed in `/robots.txt`. Product source code remains MIT.
